content: Indeed recommends reading each vacancy, identifying role-specific skills and qualifications, prioritizing relevant experience, and carefully incorporating matching language; it cautions against keyword stuffing and inaccurate AI-generated text. CareerOneStop advises standard section headings and clean formatting for resume readability/ATS compatibility. CareerOneStop and Resume.com document PDF export as common output. Jobscan and LinkedIn expose job-description matching, insights, editable suggestions, and multiple saved resumes, confirming this product pattern; LinkedIn warns users to verify suggestions for authenticity.
